editorial.blurb: A beloved gem serving authentic, home-style Mexican cuisine with generous portions and genuinely delicious, well-seasoned food that keeps locals coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go on a weekend for the Menudo—it's a must-try signature item, and don't skip the hand-made tortillas. Expect a wait since the place is always full, but it moves steadily.
